# Brand Rules (approved current state, do not revert)

- Nav colour espresso `#30251F`. **No banner above the nav.** No theme button in the nav; theme forced light. (The earlier "no search button" rule was superseded when the owner approved the demo journey on 2026-10-17: the header now has a Search icon that opens the search panel. Code confirmed 2026-10-18.)
- Hero H1 "Timeless Elegance". The large OLDVERGE heading was removed on purpose.
- Header nav: **Watches** (All Watches, Rolex, Patek Philippe, Cartier, Franck Muller, Best Win), **Clothes** (Quarter Zips), **Our Story**. "Best Win" is the supplied name, do not rename. No "New Arrivals" (no date data).
- Main categories: Watches and Clothes. Clothes contains Quarter Zips only; do not add other clothing categories.
- Product cards: photograph, then name and price on one line. **No buttons, hearts, badges or text over a photo.**
- Product page follows the "Hanger" reference: large photo at its own proportions left, name and price on one row, colour/size, full-width Add to bag, minimal text.
- Contact page follows the "Miros" reference; Our Story follows "Alder & Co."; FAQ follows a hairline accordion style.
- Do not describe the site as a demo/preview in the UI beyond the footer notice and cart/checkout statements.
- Class names: `ov-*` for current design; older unprefixed classes are in `styles.css`.
- Rejected: "Liquid Glass" style from UI UX Pro Max (not minimal), Rubik font, heavy shadows/gradients.
- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Why: these were explicit owner approvals; see [[Decision Log]].
